requirements.quote: Provide list of other accessories normally furnished by MANUFACTURER for PURCHASER review and approval.
requirements.text: Submit a list of standard accessories for review.

requirements.quote: Apply a protective epoxy powder finish to all steel surfaces of equipment. Uncoated surfaces are not permitted or acceptable.
requirements.text: Apply epoxy powder finish to all steel surfaces.

requirements.quote: Provide nameplates on all internal and front panel mounted devices. Front panel nameplates shall be attached with stainless self-tapping screws.
requirements.text: Attach nameplates to devices with stainless screws.

requirements.quote: Details of Inspection and Testing requirements will normally be detailed on a supplier standard Form.
requirements.text: Provide inspection and testing details on standard forms.

requirements.quote: The PURCHASER or authorized representative shall have access to the VENDOR’s shop procedures, schedules, testing, and inspection procedures and documents.
requirements.text: Allow access to shop procedures and documents.

requirements.quote: The VENDOR shall verify by test that the complete electrical system with its components complies with all its performance requirements.
requirements.text: Test the electrical system for compliance.

requirements.quote: The VENDOR shall provide certified test reports for all tests performed.
requirements.text: Provide certified test reports for all tests.

requirements.quote: The PURCHASER reserves the right to inspect Metal Clad Switchgear and witness all tests at the VENDORs works prior to the shipment.
requirements.text: Allow purchaser to inspect and witness tests before shipment.

requirements.quote: Manufacture complete as specified or required for operation and continuous service at the location indicated in the Contract Documents.
requirements.text: Manufacture equipment for specified operation and service.

requirements.quote: Erect equipment enclosure and all components plumb, true, and conforming to MANUFACTURER’s printed instructions.
Replace any panels or components bent or otherwise damaged as result of PURCHASERS operations, or repair if damage is minor.
requirements.text: Replace or repair damaged panels or components.

requirements.quote: The PURCHASER will perform other field testing under a separate contract, including: Field high-potential test of each breaker.
requirements.text: Field testing will be performed by purchaser.

requirements.quote: Finish Color Gray Exterior and White Interior

requirements.text: Ensure relaying accuracy meets C400 standard.

requirements.quote: Environmental Outdoor Ambient Temp Range ‐30 to +120 Degrees Fahrenheit
requirements.text: Ensure equipment operates within specified temperature range.
